value.title: Catch the Quickatoo
value.synopsis: Dora and Boots have to get a picture of an elusive rare bird for Abuela.

value.title: Lost Lorito
value.synopsis: Dora and Boots return a baby parrot home, who can't stop copying Boots.

value.title: Rainbow's Lost Colors
value.synopsis: Dora recovers three colors missing from a rainbow so the twins can see it.

value.title: Boots' Rubber Band Ball
value.synopsis: Boots has to retrieve his ball after it lands in the front yard of Cynthia the Centipede.

value.title: The Alebrije Adventure
value.synopsis: Dora helps an Alebrije recover the rainbow water needed for a special tree.

value.title: Let's Get A Paleta!
value.synopsis: On a hot day in the rainforest, Dora needs to rescue Val's paleta truck and secure icy treats for everyone.

value.title: Big Red Chicken Wake Up!
value.synopsis: Dora and Boots have to wake up the Big Red Chicken before he floats down a waterfall!

value.title: The Mystery Gift
value.synopsis: Dora and friends must solve a series of questions to open a mysterious gift.

value.title: Friendaversary Adventure
value.synopsis: Boots needs to rescue Isa on their Friendaversary!

value.title: Swiper's Birthday Surprise
value.synopsis: Dora brings a gift to a Swiper's party and must stop him from swiping his own gift and ruining the surprise.

value.title: The Little Axolotl
value.synopsis: Dora and Boots get a mischievous baby axolotl back to its mama.

value.title: Bubble Trouble
value.synopsis: Dora must save the Big Red Chicken who floats away in a bubble right before the big talent show.

value.title: Rainforest Ritmo
value.synopsis: Boots has to learn a new dance before he gets to Isa's party!

value.title: The Magic Nut
value.synopsis: Dora leads everyone into the Tricky Trappy Forest to recover a Tico's magic nut.

value.title: Tiny Dancer
value.synopsis: Bailarina loses her Adelitas, and Dora has to get them back.

value.title: The Sleepy Sun
value.synopsis: The sun refuses to set without its missing Pillow Cloud.

value.title: Tres Leches Trouble
value.synopsis: Dora helps Benny deliver a giant tres leches cake to his Abuela's house.

value.title: Wizzle Wozzle Woo
value.synopsis: Dora helps the Fiesta Trio recover their instruments after they run away from a loud, strange sound.

value.title: Croc-A-Bye Baby
value.synopsis: Dora gets baby crocs to sleep.

value.title: Wanna Empanada?
value.synopsis: The Troll refuses to get an empanada.

value.title: If The Boot Fits
value.synopsis: Boots tries on new boots.

value.title: Piñata Party
value.synopsis: The twins have problems with their first piñata.

value.title: Tico and Bip Bip's Big Show
value.synopsis: Dora has to escort Bip Bip to a concert with Tico, but he keeps shutting down.

value.title: Wonky Wishing Wand
value.synopsis: The Big Red Chicken makes himself tiny after a magical mishap, and Dora must change him back.

value.title: A Guayabera For Tico
value.synopsis: Boots wants to give a Guayabera to Tico, which can magically produce anything out of its pockets.

value.title: Falling Estrellas
value.synopsis: Dora must return three missing stars to a special constellation.
